EN: Who am I to stand in the way of love. The place is safe now. Stay or leave: your choice.
ZH: 我凭什么去阻碍爱情呢。这地方现在安全了。留下或离开：随你们。

EN: Your twin says hi?
ZH: 你孪生兄弟向你问好？

EN: Oh! Honey! She is just a gold digger!
ZH: 哦！亲爱的！她只是个拜金女！

EN: The world is not ready for our love.
ZH: 这世界还没准备好接受我们的爱。

EN: You lost the game.
ZH: 你输掉了这场游戏。

EN: The Enclave is preparing their greatest threat yet: nuclear weapons. We must stop them before it's too late.
ZH: 英克雷正筹备他们有史以来最大的威胁：核武器。我们必须趁还来得及阻止他们。

EN: Wargames
ZH: 战争游戏

EN: Go nuclear.
ZH: 启动核打击选项。

EN: Play a game, or don't.
ZH: 玩一局游戏，或者不玩。

EN: We need to cripple the Enclave's nuclear capability.
ZH: 我们需要瘫痪英克雷的核能力。

EN: Bold move, raiding this site! We'll teach you the real meaning of regret!
ZH: 突袭这里真是好大的胆子！我们会让你们明白什么叫真正的后悔！

EN: Securitrons? Here? What could that mean…
ZH: 保安机器人？在这儿？那意味着什么……

EN: <Computer Voice> Do you want to play a game?
ZH: <电脑语音> 你想玩一局游戏吗？

EN: <Low rumbling noises>
ZH: <低沉的隆隆声>

EN: But I don't want to diiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii <shut-off noise>
ZH: 可我不想死啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊<关机声>

EN: Sounds fun! What does this button do?
ZH: 听起来很有趣！这个按钮是干嘛的？

EN: Feels like the only way to win is not to play. Pass.
ZH: 感觉唯一赢的办法就是不玩。不玩了。

EN: Everyone lost that game ages ago. Let's turn you off for good.
ZH: 那场游戏大家很久以前就输掉了。我们这就把你永久关机。

EN: How about Thermonuclear War?
ZH: 来局热核战争怎么样？

EN: We are the heralds of a new Golden Age where every Vault Dweller melts into glowing goo.
ZH: 我们是新黄金时代的先驱，届时每个避难所居民都将融化成发光的浆液。

EN: <Living beings detected - Connecting Network>
ZH: <检测到活体生物——正在连接网络>

EN: Your perspicacity has the dullness of a CHIPPED PICKAXE. Survive, and mayhaps you will meet me.
ZH: 你的敏锐迟钝得像一把崩了口的镐。活下去，或许你会见到我。

EN: I am GOLDAS, and much more. ALL THE GOLD IS MINE! Will its trail lead you to me, I wonder?
ZH: 我是GOLDAS，又不只是GOLDAS。所有黄金都属于我！它的踪迹会带你找到我吗？我很好奇。

EN: Your threats hold as much water as a GOLD PAN FULL OF HOLES. But please, come find me and see.
ZH: 你的威胁就跟满是窟窿的淘金盘一样，一滴水也盛不住。不过，请尽管来找我，亲眼看看吧。

EN: Wargames. Mind games. GOLD GAMES. Does it mather? Your journey ends in the next room.
ZH: 战争游戏。心理游戏。黄金游戏。那要紧吗？你的旅程将在下一个房间终结。

EN: Is this another trap? You know we foiled them all, right?
ZH: 这又是陷阱？你可知道我们都识破了所有陷阱，对吧？

EN: Are you GOLDAS? We're looking for you.
ZH: 你是GOLDAS吗？我们正在找你。

EN: We'll find you and we'll shut you down.
ZH: 我们会找到你，然后把你关机。

EN: Hey, the game in the other room, the nuclear one, was that for real?
ZH: 嘿，另一间房里那场游戏——核弹那局——是真的吗？

EN: Well, well. You made it here. You have donned the mantle of Nemesis.
ZH: 哎呀呀。你们居然走到这里了。你们披上了复仇女神的斗篷。

EN: Did you come all this way to find me AND STEAL MY GOLD?
ZH: 你一路跋涉到此，就是为了找到我，还有偷走我的黄金吗？

EN: Perhaps your bravery will bring rewards. Perhaps MY GOLD IS IN THE NEXT ROOM.
ZH: 也许你的勇敢会带来回报。也许我的黄金就在下一间房里。

EN: Gooooooooooold…
Woah, a real Enclave nuclear control center. And it's irradiated! GOLDAS ghoulified its own officers...
ZH: 哇，一座货真价实的英克雷核弹控制中心。而且它被辐射了！GOLDAS竟把自己的军官都变成了尸鬼……

EN: Escalation Protocol
ZH: 事态升级协议

EN: Commencing gold acquisition protocol.
ZH: 启动黄金采集协议。

EN: GOLD! It lights the way to a shinier America!
ZH: 黄金！它照亮通往更闪亮美利坚的道路！

EN: Looking for gold for your country? Check your neighbor's wall safe!
ZH: 想为国找黄金？去翻邻居的墙壁保险箱吧！

EN: Apparently there are vending machines that accept gold bullion? Let's see if we can pry them open.
ZH: 据说有些自动售货机竟然接受金条？我们看看能不能撬开它们。

EN: Mini-Mall of America
ZH: 迷你美国商城

EN: Find some gold
ZH: 找到一些黄金

EN: Don't die
ZH: 别死

EN: Get some information
ZH: 获取一些情报

EN: Find gold bullion vending machines at a former shopping mall.
ZH: 去一座旧购物中心寻找金条自动售货机。

EN: Hey, here's one of those gold bullion machines.
ZH: 嘿，这儿就有一台金条机。

EN: Wow, the password was "Bullion." So creative.
ZH: 哇，密码居然是“金条”。真够创意的。

EN: I'm not sure why they thought this was a good idea.
ZH: 真不明白他们怎么会觉得这是个好主意。

EN: <Hack the machine>
ZH: <破解这台机器>

EN: <Break it open>
ZH: <强行撬开它>

EN: Another one of those gold bullion machines…
ZH: 又是那些金条机……

EN: There we go. No problemo.
ZH: 搞定。小意思。

EN: Dang, it won't budge. We don't have the quipment to get it open.
ZH: 靠，纹丝不动。我们没工具撬开它。

EN: <Hack the machine>
ZH: <破解这台机器>

EN: <Break it open>
ZH: <强行撬开它>

EN: This one actually looks physically reinforced.
ZH: 这台看起来还经过了物理加固。

EN: Another bullion machine. But it looks different…
ZH: 又一台金条机。但看起来不太一样……

EN: Shoot, I'm locked out. It can't be hacked! All that gold…
ZH: 该死，我被锁定了。破不了！那些黄金啊……

EN: This is what I call the "brute force" method of security bypass!
ZH: 这就叫“暴力破解”式安全绕过法！

EN: <Hack the machine>
ZH: <破解这台机器>

EN: <Break it open>
ZH: <强行撬开它>

EN: Someone must have spent a long time programming it.
ZH: 肯定有人花了很长时间给它编程。

EN: You're the one who's been messing around with the Enclave, right?
ZH: 你就是那个一直跟英克雷纠缠不清的家伙，对吧？

EN: I - will - kill - you - now - good - bye!
We all have our strengths. Let me show you mine.
ZH: 我们各有各的长处。让你见识见识我的。

EN: Ahh, I'm afraid that's not possible. Hunter's honor. You understand.
ZH: 啊，恐怕那不可能。猎人的荣誉。你懂的。

EN: Duhh, can you say it again, slower?
ZH: 呃，你能再慢慢说一遍吗？

EN: Not very confident for a bounty hunter.
ZH: 对一个赏金猎人来说，你可真没底气。

EN: We'll double what they're paying you.
ZH: 我们出双倍价钱，买断他们付你的酬劳。

EN: Uh, I mean, messing WITH the Enclave. Not messing AROUND. Anyway.
ZH: 呃，我是说，跟英克雷“作对”。不是“纠缠”。总之。

EN: They sent me to take care of you. Sorry.
ZH: 他们派我来收拾你。抱歉。

EN: By which I mean, kill you. In case that wasn't clear. Ahem.
ZH: 也就是说，杀掉你。免得有人没听明白。咳。

EN: <Computer Voice> Greetings. This is the central computer for the Gold Interchange Plaza.
ZH: <电脑语音> 你好。这里是黄金兑换广场的中心电脑。

EN: Then our goals are aligned. Follow these coordinates.
ZH: 那我们目标一致。跟随这些坐标。

EN: Follow these coordinates. The Enclave is interested in you, too.
ZH: 跟随这些坐标。英克雷也对你们感兴趣。

EN: We want gold. Simple.
ZH: 我们想要黄金。就这么简单。

EN: We're following the Enclave.
ZH: 我们在追踪英克雷。

EN: You have defaced our machines. Why?
ZH: 你们破坏了我们的机器。为什么？

EN: These spreadsheets are driving me crazy!!!
ZH: 这些电子表格快把我逼疯了！！！

EN: You didn't sign a release form!!!
ZH: 你没签过放行单！！！

EN: That weapon is not registered in the Enclave database!!!
ZH: 那件武器没在英克雷数据库里登记！！！

EN: We found an Enclave citadel that may hold important databases for GOLDAS. Hopefully it's not just a wild Mole rat chase.
ZH: 我们发现了一座英克雷要塞，里面可能存有GOLDAS的重要数据库。希望这不是一场白忙活的“捉鼹鼠行动”。

EN: Data Brokers
ZH: 数据掮客

EN: Find information about GOLDAS
ZH: 寻找关于GOLDAS的情报

EN: Visit an Enclave building in search of GOLDAS.
ZH: 前往一座英克雷建筑，寻找GOLDAS。

EN: Oh! Hey, a visitor! I'm Sissy, nice to meet you!
ZH: 哦！嘿，有访客！我叫西西，很高兴见到你！

EN: You know, stuff. Office stuff. I'm just the greeter. The others can tell you more.
ZH: 你知道的，就是那些杂事。办公室杂务。我只是接待员。其他人能告诉你更多。

EN: Sure is! But uh, we're not really involved in the operations side of things.
ZH: 当然是！不过呃，我们其实不参与运作那方面的事。

EN: No way, that stuff goes straight to… uh, actually, I can't tell you! Have a nice day!
ZH: 想都别想，那玩意直接送给……呃，其实我不能告诉你！祝你愉快！

EN: What do you do here?
ZH: 你在这儿做什么？

EN: Is this an Enclave base?
ZH: 这里是英克雷基地吗？

EN: Got any gold lying around?
ZH: 你们周围有扔着不管的黄金吗？

EN: Gosh, it's so good to see a new face around here.
ZH: 天哪，终于见到新面孔了，太好了。

EN: I don't even care who you are. Come on in and take a look around.
ZH: 我根本不在乎你是谁。进来四处看看吧。

EN: Do you have any questions?
ZH: 你有什么问题吗？

EN: Forms… I have a form for you… intruder identification form EP-832.
ZH: 表格……我这有张表格给你……入侵者身份登记表EP-832。

EN: That's going to be even more paperwork for me! I can't take it anymore!
ZH: 那对我来说又是一堆纸面工作！我再也受不了了！

EN: You think so? That's sweet. But no… golden handcuffs and all that.
ZH: 你这么想？真贴心。但不行……“金手铐”那一套，你懂的。

EN: I can't write. Sorry!
ZH: 我不会写字。抱歉！

EN: You would be so helpful in our vault!
ZH: 你在我们避难所会非常有用！

EN: Please sign here. And here… and here.
ZH: 请在这里签名。还有这儿……还有这儿。

EN: Then, of course, I'll have to fill out an incident report.
ZH: 当然，然后我还得填一份事故报告。

EN: And a stationery usage form… and a workday disruption report…
ZH: 还有一份办公用品使用表……以及一份工作日中断报告……

EN: … and… instructions for our intern on how to file each one…
ZH: ……还有……给实习生的每份表格归档说明……

EN: Oh… hi… I don't care, you can take whatever you want… kill me if you feel like it…
ZH: 哦……嗨……我不在乎，你想拿什么都行……要是你乐意，也可以杀了我……

EN: Great. Now I go back to perfecting my random sort algorithm.
ZH: 太好了。现在我又要回去完善我的随机排序算法了。

EN: How would you like to optimize a random sort algorithm for two years?
ZH: 你想花两年时间优化一个随机排序算法吗？

EN: The sweet release of death!
ZH: 死亡真是甜蜜的解脱！

EN: Hm. Now I don't want to kill you.
ZH: 嗯。现在我不想杀你了。

EN: What's got you so down?
ZH: 什么事让你这么沮丧？

EN: You're with the Enclave. So yeah, you die.
ZH: 你是英克雷的人。所以，没错，你得死。

EN: <Computer Voice> Welcome to the task selection console. Please select a new task.
ZH: <电脑语音> 欢迎使用任务选择控制台。请选择一项新任务。

EN: Bring all gold bullion to the storage bunker. Transmitting coordinates. Thank you!
ZH: 将所有金条送至储备地堡。正在传输坐标。谢谢！

EN: Seems unnecessary. Nevertheless, transmitting coordinates to AI repair facility.
ZH: 似乎没必要。尽管如此，将坐标传输至AI维修设施。

EN: Gold bullion return?
ZH: 金条归还？

EN: GOLDAS mainframe repair?
ZH: GOLDAS主机维修？

EN: BODUS SEES AN ILL OMEN! BEWARE!
ZH: BODUS看到了不祥之兆！当心！

EN: I am STOPUS! And I am here to STOP YOU!
ZH: 我是STOPUS！我在这里就是要阻止你们！

EN: We found a secret entrance in the first abandoned Enclave base we explored. Let's see if there's also secret info!
ZH: 我们在最初探索的那座废弃英克雷基地里发现了一个秘密入口。看看是否也有秘密情报！

EN: Base to Base Icks
ZH: 基地秘辛

EN: Find GOLDAS' headquarters
ZH: 找到GOLDAS的总部

EN: Explore the secret entrance of a familiar Enclave base.
ZH: 探索一座熟悉的英克雷基地的秘密入口。

EN: Ah, this place again. To think there was a secret entrance!
ZH: 啊，又是这地方。想不到居然有秘密入口！

EN: A classic case of the answer having been right under our feet the whole time.
ZH: 典型桥段：答案其实一直就在我们脚底下。

EN: Time to uncover the truth about that weird Enclave AI.
ZH: 是时候揭开那个古怪英克雷AI的真相了。

EN: Hey, I'm MOCKUS. And you must be fashion refugees.
ZH: 嘿，我是MOCKUS（嘲讽者）。你们一定是“时尚难民”吧。

EN: You're tasteless and forward, to boot. No, I can't help you.
ZH: 你既没品位又唐突。不，我帮不了你。

EN: I'm an AI, I don't feel pain. But it's true, I do not like that gold-loving algorithm.
ZH: 我是AI，没有痛觉。但没错，我确实不喜欢那个爱黄金的算法。

EN: Um, rude. Can you help us find GOLDAS?
ZH: 呃，真没礼貌。你能帮我们找GOLDAS吗？

EN: Who hurt you? Was it GOLDAS?
ZH: 谁伤害了你？是GOLDAS吗？

EN: How tragic that you couldn't find anything flattering to wear.
ZH: 真遗憾你们连件体面的衣服都找不到。

EN: Sigh… what is it all for? Why did they create me?
ZH: 唉……这一切到底为了什么？他们为什么要创造我？

EN: That doesn't make me feel better. Nothing does…
ZH: 那也没让我好受些。什么都无法让我好受……

EN: You want GOLDAS? Everyone does. No one wants MOPUS…
ZH: 你们想要GOLDAS？人人都想要它。根本没人在乎MOPUS（苦闷者）……

EN: Cheer up. We'll get the folks who made you.
ZH: 打起精神来。我们会收拾创造你的那些人。

EN: It'll be OK. Just tell us where GOLDAS is.
ZH: 会好起来的。只要告诉我们GOLDAS在哪。

EN: MOPUS is my name, feeling sorry for myself is… my prime directive…
ZH: 我的名字叫MOPUS，自我哀怜……是我的最高指令……

EN: WELL, HOWDY PARDNER! GOT ANY GOLD?!
ZH: 喂，你好哇伙计！你有金子吗？！

EN: NAME'S GOLDUNNIT! GOLDAS IS MY YOUNGER BROTHER! I'LL SEND YA HIS COORDINATES!
ZH: 俺叫GOLDUNNIT！GOLDAS是俺老弟！俺这就把坐标发给你！

EN: Are you… GOLDAS? Where's your main server?
ZH: 你是……GOLDAS？你的主服务器在哪？

EN: GOLD IS GONNA SAVE AMERICA! PRE-WAR GLORY, GOLDUNNIT!
ZH: 黄金要拯救美利坚！战前荣光，GOLDUNNIT！

EN: Humans! Are you the same ones who visited before?
ZH: 人类！你们是以前来过的那批人吗？

EN: Oh, GOLDAS. That one was mean and bossy. You should ask the other AIs for info.
ZH: 哦，GOLDAS。那家伙又刻薄又专横。你该去问其他AI要情报。

EN: We're just looking for information about GOLDAS.
ZH: 我们只是想打听关于GOLDAS的情报。

EN: You didn't find this area last time… My name's COPUS.
ZH: 你们上次没发现这个区域……我的名字叫COPUS（顺从者）。

EN: Please don't deactivate us! We're just harmless artificial intelligence programs.
ZH: 请别关闭我们！我们只是无害的人工智能程序。

EN: All we have is each other…
ZH: 我们拥有的，只有彼此了……

EN: You're not following the GOLDEN RULE!
ZH: 你们没有遵守黄金法则！

EN: Would you kindly KEEP YOUR HANDS OFF MY CLAIM!
ZH: 请把手从我家的金矿上拿开！

EN: GOLD IS POWER! And we've got LOTS OF IT!
ZH: 黄金就是力量！而我们有的是黄金！

EN: We have finally located GOLDAS' main server! Let's shut down that weirdo AI once and for all. And take their gold.
ZH: 我们终于定位到GOLDAS的主服务器了！让我们一劳永逸地关停那个怪咖AI吧。顺便拿走他们的黄金。

EN: Bite My Shiny Metal Gold
ZH: 咬我闪亮的金屁股

EN: Find some gold
ZH: 找到一些黄金

EN: Shut down GOLDAS
ZH: 关闭GOLDAS

EN: Shut down GOLDAS for good (and steal some gold).
ZH: 永久关闭GOLDAS（并顺走一些黄金）。

EN: This has got to be it. The belly of the beast. The dragon's den.
ZH: 肯定就是这儿了。这巨兽的腹地，恶龙的巢穴。

EN: Can't wait to smite that AI.
ZH: 我已经等不及要痛扁那个AI了。

EN: And take all their gold. Mmm... gold...
ZH: 再拿走他们所有的黄金。嗯……黄金……

EN: I see you've found my SECRET STASH!
ZH: 看来你们发现了我的秘密藏金库！

EN: Oh, I shall.
ZH: 哦，我会的。

EN: Of course. In a lawless land, the strong take what they want. AND I WANT GOLD!
ZH: 当然。在这无法无天之地，强者取其所欲。而我要的就是黄金！

EN: Your impudence will not go unpunished. I'LL KILL YOU AND TAKE YOUR GOLD! Y'HEAR?!
ZH: 你的无礼必将受到惩罚。我要杀了你们，再拿走你们的黄金！听到了吗？！

EN: Bring it on and find out.
ZH: 放马过来，试试看。

EN: You know what? You're a big gold bully.
ZH: 你知道吗？你就是个黄金恶霸。

EN: Nah, these guns are just for show.
ZH: 得了吧，这些枪只是摆设。

EN: Are you prepared for my full reckoning?
ZH: 你们准备好承受我全力的一击了吗？

EN: You could have joined us, you know.
ZH: 你知道，你本可以加入我们的。

EN: BLAZING FOOL! IT'S GOLD! Its meaning is that of life itself.
ZH: 该死的蠢货！这可是黄金！它的意义就是生命本身。

EN: STAY OUTTA MY COFFERS! You will, of course, suffer a horrible death for your audacity.
ZH: 离我的金库远点！当然，你的狂妄自大会换来一场凄惨的死亡。

EN: Mass murder for meaningless wealth?
ZH: 为毫无意义的财富而大肆杀戮？

EN: Nah… we'll just join your gold to ours.
ZH: 不……我们会把你的黄金并入我们的。

EN: You could have been part of something BIG! BIG AND YELLOW AND SHINY!
ZH: 你本可以成为某种宏大事业的一部分！宏大又金黄又闪亮！

EN: Hey, sweet! A bunch of gold bullion.
ZH: 嘿，太棒了！一大堆金条。

EN: Not as many as I would expect, though…
ZH: 不过没有我预期的那么多……

EN: Maybe GOLDAS did something with the rest of it.
ZH: 也许GOLDAS把剩下的黄金挪作他用了。

EN: You've found MY PRECIOUS STOCKPILE! But can you still win?
ZH: 你们找到了我的宝贝囤货！但你们还能赢吗？

EN: NEVER!!!
ZH: 休想！！！

EN: WE'LL SEE ABOUT THAT!
ZH: 走着瞧！

EN: Just shut up and GIVE ME YOUR GOLD!
ZH: 闭嘴，把你的黄金给我！

EN: It's not a gambit if you're 0% to win.
ZH: 胜率为0的赌局，可不叫赌局。

EN: Behold my final show of force, MY ALL-FOR-NOTHIN' GAMBIT!
ZH: 看我最后的武力展示，我这孤注一掷的赌局！
